changelog:
Initial release.

- Audits cancelled and timed-out GitHub Actions runs to identify wasted CI minutes from JSON exports.
- Groups waste by repository, workflow, and conclusion for efficient triage.
- Supports configurable warning and critical minute thresholds with optional workflow/repo/actor filters.
- Outputs in either text (for report) or JSON (for integration), with exit code signaling for CI usage.
- Requires bash and python3.
summary: Audit cancelled and timed-out GitHub Actions runs from JSON exports to surface wasted CI minutes and noisy workflows.
